content.title: Setting Up a NOWPayments Digital Store: The Full Guide

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters

This is a self-hosted, fully owned digital commerce stack designed for creators in regions where traditional payment platforms fail. It combines GitHub Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers for backend logic, and NOWPayments for crypto payment processing. The result? A system that lets you sell digital products globally, accept 300+ cryptocurrencies, and retain full data ownership. No subscriptions, no platform lock-in, and no reliance on third-party services that might restrict your access.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The stack operates on a decentralized model. GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages hosts your static site, while Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script handles backend logic like order processing. Payments are routed through NOWPayments, which verifies on-chain transactions and triggers a webhook to deliver the product. Order data is stored in Supabase or Google Sheets, and files are delivered via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. This architecture ensures low fees, instant delivery, and complete sovereignty over your infrastructure.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This solution is for creators selling ebooks, courses, templates, or software in regions where Stripe, PayPal, and Gumroad are unavailable or unreliable. It’s also for those who want to bypass payout delays, currency restrictions, and platform fees. By leveraging crypto payments, you gain access to a global market without depending on intermediaries. The system is pressure-tested in environments like Zimbabwe, where financial isolation and currency collapse are realities.
NOWPayments charges just 0.5% per transaction—no hidden fees, no KYC.
The Components That Make It Work Together

GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages provides free, reliable hosting. Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script handles backend logic, ensuring your site remains lightweight and fast. NOWPayments processes crypto payments with a 0.5% fee, supporting networks like BSC, Solana, and TRON for low transaction costs. Supabase or Google Sheets stores order data, while Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 delivers files securely. Each component is chosen for its reliability, cost-effectiveness, and ease of integration.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

Start by choosing a hosting platform—GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Set up your backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Integrate NOWPayments by configuring your API keys and webhook URL. Store order data in Supabase or Google Sheets and host your files on Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Test the entire flow end-to-end to ensure payments trigger instant product delivery. Once deployed, you own the entire stack—no platform dependence, no subscriptions, and lifetime access.
How do I receive crypto payments for my digital products?

To receive crypto payments for your digital products, integrate NOWPayments with your static site. Set up a payment form, configure NOWPayments API keys, and create a webhook to trigger product delivery upon payment confirmation. Use networks like TRON or Solana for low fees—under $0.10 per transaction. This eliminates reliance on platforms like Stripe or Gumroad and ensures instant payouts directly to your wallet.
TRON and Solana networks ensure transaction fees under $0.10, ideal for micro-payments.

If you’re ready to deploy this system, the Complete Builder Kit ($197) includes all 6 blueprints and 7 templates for instant download. It’s everything you need to build, deploy, and scale a sovereign digital commerce stack. For creators in Nigeria, Ghana, or Kenya, this kit also includes guides for converting crypto to local currency via P2P exchanges like Binance or Patricia. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to get started.
Your Deployment Checklist

Choose your hosting platform: GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Set up backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Integrate NOWPayments by configuring API keys and webhook URLs. Store order data in Supabase or Google Sheets. Host product files on Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Test the entire flow end-to-end to ensure payments trigger instant delivery. Deploy your stack and start selling globally.
Frequently Asked Questions
How long does a USDT payment take compared to PayPal?
USDT payments on TRON or Solana confirm in seconds, with network fees under $0.10. PayPal payouts can take days and incur higher fees, often with restrictions in regions like Nigeria or Ghana.
How do creators in Nigeria convert Bitcoin to naira?
Use P2P exchanges like Binance or Patricia to convert Bitcoin to naira directly. These platforms offer competitive rates and instant settlements, bypassing traditional banking restrictions.
What networks does NOWPayments support for low fees?
NOWPayments supports BSC, Solana, and TRON, with transaction fees under $0.10. These networks are ideal for low-cost, high-speed transactions.
Can I use this stack if I’m not a developer?
Yes. The Complete Builder Kit ($197) includes step-by-step blueprints and templates for non-developers. Everything is designed for easy deployment, even without coding experience.
What happens after deployment?
After deployment, you own the entire stack. COREMERCH has no access, and you retain full control over your data, payments, and product delivery. No subscriptions, no platform lock-in.
